public_rationale: Marcus said AI is real and named everyday tools such as speech recognition, navigation, web search and recommendations. On 2024-10-29, Google said all seven of its products and platforms with more than 2 billion monthly users use its Gemini models, including Google Maps (e1). On the same date, Google said AI Overviews in Search had started rolling out to more than a hundred new countries and territories that week, and would now reach more than 1 billion users a month (e2). These 2024 company disclosures show AI built into widely used web search and maps products before the post date. That meets the support condition. The packet found no evidence that these products did not use AI. A Pew survey fielded in December 2022 (e3) found 27% of US adults said they interact with AI at least several times a day. It predates the 2024 window and is context only.
limitations: Marcus's own daily use cannot be checked and is not scored.
The 2024 evidence comes from one company's own disclosures and was not independently verified.
The billion-user figure for AI Overviews is Google's statement of expected monthly reach after a rollout, not a measured 2024 total.
The packet does not separately document AI in speech recognition or recommendation products for 2024.
